Software Engineer Intern (Summer 2027)

> ENFOS, Inc. · Durham, United States · Full-time · Posted 2026-09-04

Workplace: on_site

Department: Engineer

Description

ENFOS is redefining how global enterprises manage long-term environmental risk. As the category leader in Environmental Obligation Management, our platform centralizes and automates the full lifecycle of Environmental Remediation Obligations (EROs) and Asset Retirement Obligations (AROs)—replacing fragmented spreadsheets and outdated tools with a purpose-built, multi-tenant SaaS platform.

For 25 years, ENFOS has helped the world’s leading industrial companies stay audit-ready, SOX-compliant, and financially in control of their environmental obligations. Privately held and profitable, ENFOS operates with no direct competitors and supports a blue-chip customer base spanning energy and natural resources, chemicals, manufacturing, and logistics end markets.

With regulatory pressure rising and ESG scrutiny intensifying, ENFOS is uniquely positioned to empower Finance, Legal, and Remediation teams to improve decision-making, mitigate risk, and drive long-term balance sheet reliability.

About the Role

As a Software Engineering Intern at ENFOS, you will work alongside experienced engineers building and modernizing an enterprise SaaS platform used to manage complex environmental and financial obligations.

This is a hands-on engineering internship. You will contribute to real product development and may work across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, data processing, document management, AI-enabled capabilities, or platform infrastructure depending on your technical strengths and current product initiatives.

You will participate in the same engineering practices used by our development teams, including design discussions, implementation, code reviews, testing, and iterative delivery, and gain experience building reliable, secure, and scalable enterprise software.

We are looking for interns who have strong computer science fundamentals, enjoy solving difficult problems, and are comfortable learning beyond a single technology stack.

How We Work:                                          

-   Agile development: Work in two-week sprints with clear goals, ownership, collaboration, and rapid iteration.

-   Engineering quality: Build production-quality software with an emphasis on clean architecture, automated testing, code reviews, security, performance, and long-term maintainability.
-   Modern technology stack: Gain hands-on experience across our technology stack, including Java, Spring Boot, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, WebSockets, GitLab, Docker, Ansible, and CI/CD, as well as modern AI-assisted development tools.
-   End-to-end engineering: Depending on the project, work across frontend, backend, APIs, data, AI-enabled capabilities, and platform services rather than being limited to a single area of the technology stack.
-   Engineer ownership: Take initiative, solve real problems, and contribute ideas that improve the performance, scalability, reliability, and user experience of the ENFOS platform.
-   Mentorship and growth: Work closely with experienced engineers, participate in technical design and code reviews, and develop the skills needed to build and understand enterprise-scale software systems.

Responsibilities

As a Software Engineering Intern at ENFOS, you will work alongside experienced engineers to design, build, test, and improve production software used by global enterprises to manage complex environmental and financial obligations. Depending on your skills, interests, and project needs, you may contribute across frontend, backend, data, AI-enabled features, or platform engineering.

You will have opportunities to:

-   Build production software: Design, develop, test, and enhance features across the ENFOS platform using modern software engineering practices.
-   Develop user-facing experiences: Build responsive, intuitive interfaces and reusable components using technologies such as React and TypeScript.
-   Build backend services and APIs: Develop application services, business logic, integrations, and REST APIs using technologies such as Java and Spring Boot.
-   Work with data and documents: Build capabilities for processing, validating, transforming, and presenting complex environmental, financial, and transactional data.
-   Contribute to AI-enabled capabilities: Work on projects involving document intelligence, natural-language interfaces, automation, forecasting, or other AI-assisted workflows where applicable.
-   Solve real engineering problems: Investigate requirements, evaluate technical approaches, troubleshoot issues, and implement maintainable solutions.
-   Integrate across the application stack: Connect frontend applications with backend services, APIs, databases, and other platform capabilities.
-   Improve performance and scalability: Identify opportunities to improve application responsiveness, reliability, maintainability, and scalability.
-   Write high-quality code: Follow engineering standards for architecture, testing, code reviews, security, documentation, and maintainability.
-   Collaborate across teams: Work with engineering, product, design, and implementation teams to translate business requirements into working software.
-   Use modern development tools: Gain hands-on experience with GitLab, CI/CD, Docker, automated testing, AI-assisted development tools, and enterprise development workflows.
-   Contribute to real enterprise systems: Work on production-quality software while receiving mentorship and technical guidance from experienced engineers.

Requirements

We are looking for students with strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn new technologies quickly. You do not need experience with every technology listed below.

-   Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
-   Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and core computer science concepts
-   Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, such as Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript
-   Experience building software through coursework, personal projects, internships, research, or other hands-on development
-   Understanding of fundamental software engineering concepts including modular design, debugging, testing, and maintainable code
-   Familiarity with Git and version-control workflows
-   Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to break complex problems into manageable technical solutions
-   Ability and willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies, frameworks, and areas of the application stack
-   Strong attention to code quality, structure, readability, and maintainability
-   Ability to communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with engineers and cross-functional teams
-   Interest in using AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of the software development process

Experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus, but not required:

-   Frontend: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, responsive UI development
-   Backend: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, distributed application development
-   Data and AI: Python, machine learning, LLMs, document processing, embeddings, data engineering
-   Databases: SQL, PostgreSQL, relational data modeling
-   Platform and DevOps: Docker, Linux, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, messaging or distributed systems
-   Software quality: Automated testing, performance optimization, secure coding, or accessibility

Benefits

-   Competitive internship compensation aligned with market rates
-   Flexible, rolling start and end dates set individually to fit your academic calendar
-   Potential to continue part-time during the school year for strong performers, subject to business need and work authorization
-   Opportunity to gain hands-on experience working with a high-performing engineering team
-   Exposure to real-world projects supporting enterprise-scale systems
-   Professional mentorship, learning, and career development throughout the internship

Apply

[Apply at ENFOS, Inc.](https://apply.workable.com/enfos-inc/j/CA15908E0A/apply)

About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

As a Software Engineer Intern, you will be shown how to build Zip’s core products and architecture. You will ship features that will be immediately used by our users and will work with a tight-knit team that values open communication and cross-functional collaboration. We move quickly to solve a wide range of complex technical and product challenges. While we are an experienced team that can provide constant guidance and mentorship, we value engineers who can scope and solve difficult technical challenges.

Previous interns have worked on:

- Internal AI bot: a bot that uses generative AI to aggregate info from various sources (e.g. google doc, notion, Slack, Zip help site) and generate answers - it’s now actively used by both engineering and customer teams at Zip

- Devbox: building a prototype that bootstraps the development environment in AWS cloud for all zip engineers - this project is now being used by 80+ engineers

- Virtual Card Auto Lock: a feature that automatically locks virtual cards based on various policies, such as after a certain expiration date, when reported lost, or in the event of an overdraft. This feature, along with a self-serve onboarding tool, is now live in our virtual card product

You Will

- Design and build highly reliable and resilient products and features

- Work closely with cross-functional product and customer-facing teams to understand requirements and ship thoughtful solutions

- Write high-quality, extensible, and maintainable code

- Design and build scalable frontend applications and components

- Design and build APIs to drive existing and new features for a web-based application

Qualifications

- Pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science or a related technical field involving coding (e.g. physics or math), with an expected graduation date between December 2027 - June 2028

- Experience with web applications and API development. At Zip, our stack includes Python, Javascript/TypeScript, React, and GraphQL

- Ability and interest to quickly learn new frameworks, architecture patterns, and programming languages as needed

- Fantastic written and verbal communication skills

- Prior internship in a high-growth startup environment

Our internships are full-time and hybrid, based in our San Francisco HQ office. Our Summer 2027 internship runs either May–August or June–September.

The estimated hourly pay range for this role is $56 - 60 per hour.

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work

- 🍽️ Catered breakfasts, lunches & dinners

- 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

- 💻 Apple equipment

- 🏠 Intern Housing stipend

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

About us

Forus is building an AI-powered network that connects doctors, pharmacies, payers, and biopharma to accelerate new science to patients.

Our platform automates the complexity between a doctor prescribing a medicine and a patient starting treatment, including insurance coverage, financial assistance, and supply chain navigation. We provide this support free to doctors and patients, helping them get life-changing medicine faster, cheaper, and easier. The resulting network enables biopharma companies to design better research, launch new drugs more effectively, and invest in harder-to-treat conditions.

Forus has exceptional product-market fit and is growing rapidly through organic adoption:

- Accelerating scale: We already support patients across more than 85% of ZIP codes and partner with 9 of top 15 largest biopharma companies in the world.

- AI-native, durable model: Our business becomes stronger as AI improves, as every new doctor, patient, and partner makes the network more valuable.

- Backing to build for the long term: We raised $300M+ from leading investors to build an exceptional team and unlock the full scale of the opportunity.

Our number one priority is scaling to market demand. We are looking for individuals who are high horsepower, high throughput, and hyper resourceful to help us increase capacity and grow. We move fast and need to move faster.

If we succeed, science will be the only limit to medicine.

All full-time roles are in person in New York.

About the role

As a Software Engineering Intern at Forus, you will join our engineering team as an engineer, not as an observer. From your first weeks, you’ll ship production code, own meaningful technical problems, and build software that helps providers, patients, and life sciences organizations bring innovative therapies to more patients.

Unlike a traditional internship, you’ll work on the same systems as our full-time engineers and contribute to the same codebase, engineering reviews, and technical discussions. You’ll work directly with experienced engineers, the head of engineering, and the CEO on some of the company’s highest-priority technical challenges, whether that’s provider-facing products, AI systems, life sciences platforms, growth acceleration, or infrastructure. This isn’t an internship spent building internal demos or isolated side projects. You will help build the platform that sits between scientific innovation and patient treatment, working on the products and AI systems that providers and biopharma depend on every day.

We invest in exceptional interns differently than most companies. Many stay with us across multiple semesters, take on increasing ownership as they grow, and some receive return offers and start vesting equity before they graduate. We think the best engineers should start building their careers early, and we’re looking for people we hope will help define Forus for years to come.

This is a demanding role, with a high level of autonomy and responsibility. You will be expected to “act like an owner” and commit yourself to Forus’ success. If you are low-ego, hungry to learn, and excited about intense, impactful work that drives both company growth and accelerated career progression, we want to hear from you.

Please note that we hire Interns year-round.

If you join, you will

- Own meaningful technical problems from an ambiguous idea through design, implementation, and production

- Ship production code that directly impacts providers, patients, and life sciences partners.

- Help decide what to build, not just how to build it, by working closely with users and developing your own product intuition

- Build product features, AI-powered systems, life sciences products, internal tools, or engineering infrastructure, depending on where you can have the greatest impact

- Work directly with engineering, product, design, operations, and company leadership while learning how a world-class engineering organization operates and scales

- Be treated and measured like a full engineer, with the ownership, code review, and quality bar to match

We’ll be most excited if you have

- Strong computer science fundamentals and programming ability, currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a related technical field

- A track record of building things outside the classroom, whether through internships, research, startups, hackathons, open-source contributions, or side projects

- Strong product instincts. You form opinions about what is worth building and can distinguish what is valuable from what is merely possible
